resources.string: Original repositories are pinned in Saba Studio. These are complete source references, not installed or activated features. Each application needs a compatible adapter and tests before runtime use.
Status: source preserved — not integrated into the APK
Code from this repository must not be bundled without rights-holder authorization.

Import %1$s as a separate local coding workspace at its exact pinned commit? This downloads external code and does not execute it. Git tools and storage space are required. Existing projects remain unchanged.
Imported %1$s into a new local workspace.
Detect locally installed coding CLIs in the selected workspace. You must sign in to each CLI separately. Nothing is installed or run automatically.
Select a workspace with shell access first.
I understand this CLI may access or modify project files. Allow editing when required.
Run %1$s in the selected workspace? This may execute tools, access files or use a connected AI service. Review your prompt, shell access and permissions first.
I confirm I have the required rights to obtain and use this source. Download does not grant redistribution rights.
Nested Git repositories may also be downloaded, require significant storage, and have separate licenses. An incomplete download is not registered.
Select 2-4 installed agents to review the same task in read-only/plan/dry-run mode. Each agent may use paid API credits.
Send this task to %1$d AI agents? They may contact remote AI providers and consume your account credits. No source files are intentionally modified.
Resume session (Claude/Gemini UUID or OpenCode ses_ ID, optional)
Uses an existing session in this workspace; prior conversation context may be accessed. Sign-in and approval remain required.
